`agent-reach-doctor-1.5.0.txt` and `agent-reach-help-1.5.0.txt` are the real output of `agent-reach doctor` and
`agent-reach --help` on the owner's Mac (Agent Reach v1.5.0, pasted 11 November 2026), kept whole: they carry no
account, path or name. `agent-reach doctor --text` is not a command in that version (argparse: "unrecognized
arguments: --text"). These are the only real agent-reach answers the collector has been tested against.
